description: This file defines the SignatureProvider class, which provides methods for resolving, creating, and caching signature objects used for AWS request signing. It includes handling for various signature versions and external dependencies related to signature creation.

classes.name: SignatureProvider
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to resolve, generate, and cache signature objects for AWS request signing, supporting different signature versions and external authorization types.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a signature object for the given version, service, and region, throwing an exception if unable to do so.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns a default signature provider callback with memoization.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a signature provider callback with a caching mechanism to prevent redundant object creation.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Creates and returns a callback that generates signature objects based on specified signature version strings.
